mentions.name: Scorchball TV
mentions.description: A 24/7 live sports channel simulated in pixel art. It is a static site with no server; every viewer's browser simulates the same league from a published daily seed, so everyone watching sees the same synchronized broadcast at the same time. Built as a hobby project using Claude Code.
mentions.source_excerpt: I used Claude Code to create a little hobby project: a 24/7 live sports channel, simulated in pixel art, called Scorchball TV.
